# Key numbers (synthetic data) - generated by scripts/key_numbers.py


## Hypotheses

- H1: SUPPORTED - 12-1 momentum long-short earns a positive gross return (mean 0.58%/month, Newey-West t = 3.59)
- H2: not supported - Momentum top decile beats same-universe EW net of costs and taxes (test period) (-0.52 pp/yr, 95% CI [-3.62, +2.48])
- H3: SUPPORTED - The best grid variant beats EW after correcting for all variants tried (SPA p = 0.005, Reality Check p = 0.025 (12 variants))
- H4: not supported - Low-volatility decile has a higher Sharpe ratio than EW (gross) (Sharpe 0.41 vs 0.41; 95% CI of difference [-0.10, 0.09])
- H5a: not supported - 1-month reversal long-short is profitable gross (mean -0.33%/month, t = -2.21)
- H5b: SUPPORTED - Reversal top decile does NOT beat EW net of costs (test period) (-9.15 pp/yr, 95% CI [-12.79, -5.58])
